definitions.explanation: Strong enthusiasm and dedication shown in pursuit of a goal or activity.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{熱意|ねつい}に{心|こころ}を{動|うご}かされた。
examples.english: I was moved by her enthusiasm.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{仕事|しごと}への{熱意|ねつい}は{素晴|すば}らしい。
examples.english: His enthusiasm for work is wonderful.

examples.japanese: {熱意|ねつい}を{持|も}って{取|と}り{組|く}むことが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to work on things with enthusiasm.

examples.japanese: {面接|めんせつ}では{熱意|ねつい}を{伝|つた}えることが{大切|たいせつ}で、{自分|じぶん}がその{仕事|しごと}にどれだけ{興味|きょうみ}があるかを{話|はな}した。
examples.english: Conveying enthusiasm is important in job interviews, so I talked about how interested I am in the job.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熱意|ねつい}を{持|も}つ (to have enthusiasm)
- {熱意|ねつい}を{示|しめ}す (to show enthusiasm)
- {熱意|ねつい}が{ある|ある} (to be enthusiastic)
- {熱意|ねつい}に{欠|か}ける (to lack enthusiasm)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {情熱|じょうねつ} - passion (more intense/emotional)
- {意欲|いよく} - motivation, eagerness
- やる{気|き} - motivation (casual)
